entities.summary: Pedro Urbina Montoya, O.F.M. or Pedro de Urbina y Montoya was a Roman Catholic prelate who served as Archbishop of Seville (1658–1663), Archbishop of Valencia (1648–1658), and Bishop of Coria (1644–1648).
